Name: Utility Grid Storage
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod adds the following [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10197]Utility Grid[/url] objects using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365]Dynamic Game Assets[/url]:

[list]
[*][b]Utility Grid Battery[/b] - Holds up to 50 electricity, charges up to 2 electricity per hour.
[*][b][/b][b]Utility Grid Advanced Battery[/b] - Holds up to 100 electricity, charges up to 5 electricity per hour.
[*][b]Utility Grid Water Tank[/b] - Holds up to 50 water, fills up to 2 water per hour.
[/list]
Storage objects use excess power to fill, and discharge if the grid has insufficient power.

You can buy the storage items from Robin or build them yourself if your Farming skill is high enough.


This mod requires the following mods to work:

[list]
[*] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10197]Utility Grid[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365]Dynamic Game Assets[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[/list]

[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires SDV 1.5.5+

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
